name: SaaS Repo Rescue Audit
pain: Your repo looks green but hides a broken checkout, webhook, or tenant-bleed that costs trust and revenue.
offer: SaaS repo rescue audit: buyer-path tests, risk-ranked findings, remediation plan. Founder: ship safe. Enterprise: pass the review. Solo-dev: know it stays working.
headline: Find the production path that is costing your SaaS trust before a customer does.
price: $499 fixed-scope audit / $1,500 fix sprint after findings review

faq.a: The agreed repository and deployed buyer path: auth, tenant boundaries, billing/checkout, webhook verification, fulfillment, health checks, tests, and release controls relevant to your stack.
A prioritized evidence register, reproducible findings, recommended fixes, rollback notes, and a concise leadership summary. No production change is made without approval.
The fixed audit price does not include implementation, penetration testing, legal advice, or unrestricted source-code review. Any fix sprint is separately approved after findings review.
